mkdir.reason: Basic creation is supported; -p and explicit mode changes fail with ENOSYS instead of claiming unsupported permission semantics.

mv.reason: Same-volume native rename publishes both namespaces atomically and preserves open source and replaced destination objects.

rm.reason: Unlink removes a name and updates durable link counts. Open capabilities remain usable; the delegated view root is protected.

sed.reason: Stream/file-to-stdout editing is supported. -i fails without replacing the original file; unsupported metadata preservation is checked.

awk.reason: Fields, regex, arithmetic/libm, system and command streams use native adapters. Commands remain subject to native argument, child and fd limits; SPAWN uses the shared 1024-Handle capacity.
